verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 description "for code generators," a CLI with `--json` and `cafe api`, and an MCP server. None of these is an official SDK library. An OpenAPI spec that users can feed to generators is a developer building block, and the CLI and MCP server are adjacent features, so none earns credit for this story. Official SDKs are a fair axis for a Git forge, so the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".
